name: TC-461: an order HQ places on the restaurant's behalf (charge) is the owner's order, with an admin-named design and no leaked notes
description: POST /api/admin/supply-shop/orders — the on-behalf path HQ's tools use (the old 'Place order for a restaurant' form is gone; the button now opens the restaurant's own shop, TC-1126). The order is IN_DESIGN on the card on file, the design is named for the product and date with '(admin)', HQ's internal notes stay on HQ's side, and the owner's list carries neither the notes nor who placed it.
